The Dollar-Euro Exchange Rate

Charles Gave

Gavekal Research | 18 Nov 2026

The two major currencies of the Western world have been mired in an ugliness contest since around the time of the global financial crisis, and it is hard to say which is the least attractive. Over the past week, the euro has fallen below US$1.10 for the first time since April 2025. Nevertheless, the exchange rate between the two currencies is probably one of the most important prices in the world when it comes to forming an investment strategy. And from a technical perspective, we may be nearing a period of violent exchange rate movements.Consider the chart below.
